_used_for: brain-shots.mjs validates every fixture against this: a fixture may not carry a field the page does not read, or miss one it does. The machine, model and top-level key sets are read from `sample` below, not retyped. Two things are declared by hand because one sample cannot show them: the speed shapes other than the one in the sample (mirrors SpeedDto), and which bandwidth_basis values each runs_on allows (mirrors kalsa_probe::path and soc — a GPU path is never "measured", because the CPU probe cannot time it: it is a "floor", or the chip's own figure).
